clues.title: Half-burned ledger page
clues.flavor: Fished from the wastebasket, only half burned. The surviving numbers show three years of quietly skimmed commissions - all funneled through Elena's approvals.

clues.title: Hidden second ledger
clues.flavor: Taped beneath a desk drawer. The real numbers, next to the ones shown to Marcus and the accountant.

clues.title: Bank transfer statement
clues.flavor: Regular transfers to an account that isn't the gallery's. The dates line up with the discrepancies in the second ledger.

clues.title: Unsent letter, unrelated hand
clues.flavor: Colin Hargrove's handwriting, addressed to Marcus, full of old grievances about the family trust. Angry, but it's about the past - dated over a year ago.

clues.title: Printed email thread
clues.flavor: Damon Reyes accusing Marcus of selling forgeries under his name. Furious, but it ends with Damon threatening a lawsuit - not violence.

clues.title: Desk calendar
clues.flavor: Dentist appointment circled in red. Not relevant.
